decisions.statement: A shadow says which checkout that shadow is cast over.
A shadow answers whether a file is at a path once the change lands.
A shadow lists the files the change leaves under the checkout.
That listing is one search of the tree rather than a reading of an index.
A path the change writes is listed though no body sits on disk.
A path the change takes away is left out though a body sits on disk.
A caller naming no folder is listed every file under the checkout.
A caller naming a folder is listed the files sitting in that folder.
A folder's files come from that one listing rather than from a second search.
The files are listed at the first ask and held for that shadow.
No index is read to say which files the checkout holds.
A page the change has is read from the body the change has.
A page the change does not carry is read at the commit the change starts from.
A page no commit holds is read from the body on disk at that page's path.
The commit a change starts from is the commit that change names.
A change naming no commit starts from the commit at HEAD as the shadow is made.
A body read at that commit is read once for a path and held for that reading.
No page a commit holds is read from the working tree while a change is judged.
A shadow cast over no change reads a body through a reading of the repository.
A body is read at the shadow's first ask rather than when the change was taken.
A body is read once for a path and held for the life of the memo handed in.
A caller handing in a memo has a page value read once for that caller's life.
A value a reader works out from a shadow is held against that shadow and made once.
A path a settle had is forgotten from the memo handed in.
No page but the one asked for is read to answer for that page's path.
A check judging a change reads the index the change leaves rather than the committed index.
A shadow over a change that moves something holds the index to no commit.
A shadow over a change that moves nothing holds the index to the commit at HEAD.
A shadow answers the index's questions through a face of its own.
That face is bound to the reading the shadow has.
Nothing but that face reaches the shadow's reading.
A shadow worked out for a change comes back beside the reading that shadow was bound over.
Every way a shadow is made binds that face.
The entry files the change writes are worked out by the same rule a landing settles by.
A shadow answers the body of each entry file the change writes beside the index it leaves.
Those bodies are worked out at the first ask and held for that shadow.
A shadow answers the refusals the change leaves beside the entry files the change writes.
A refusal the world already had is no refusal the change leaves.
A refusal the world already had is dropped however often the change leaves it.
A shadow over a change that moves nothing answers no refusal.
A caller setting that index up elsewhere writes the entry files the change files.
The shadow lies over the committed index and has only the entry files the change touches.
A shadow settles a path some page claims and leaves every other path as the commit had it.
A body that must be loaded is reached at the path on disk with the body.
Which side of the change the checkout holds is read from disk rather than assumed.
A body the checkout already holds at the change's own path is at that path.
A body the change only has elsewhere is at the path the body came from.
A body the change rewrites where the body already was is loaded as it was before.
A body the change writes anew is at no path and is answered as nothing.
A path the change does not carry has its own body.
An audit leaves everything as everything is.
There the committed index is the answer worked out from nothing.
A change answering `before` and `after` with one reader is a change nothing moved in.
A shadow that could not be worked out is refused rather than answered from the committed index.
One change is one shadow held against the change itself.
A shadow over a change is asked for one way.
A shadow is worked out over a reading a caller hands in.
A caller handing in no reading is answered over the reading at the root.
A reading a settle left has the change that settle was handed.
Settling one change and then a second leaves the reading both changes leave.
A shadow handed to a reader that may never read the shadow is worked out at the first reading.
Nothing is copied and no scratch directory is made.
Nothing here writes to the index.
A page the shadow's index names is a page the change answers a body for.

definition: the files and index as a change would leave them
